resources.string: Takes effect after restarting the game. Automatic uses the CJK fallback when system fonts are missing.
BCFNT / shared_font.bin; no font CIA installation required

The app includes a CJK fallback with common simplified and traditional Chinese characters, kana and symbols. You can import an uncompressed BCFNT or shared_font.bin and select it globally or for one game. Importing selects the imported-font mode. Restart the game after changing fonts. TTF and CIA files cannot be imported here. This affects games that use the 3DS shared font; games with their own fonts are unaffected.
Clear selection and use automatic mode
